title: Reserve Bank of India imposes monetary penalty on IndusInd Bank Limited
description: <cite index="45-1">RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹59.20 lakh on IndusInd Bank Limited for non-compliance with certain provisions of directions issued by RBI on 'Interest Rate on Deposits' and 'Securitisation of Standard Assets'.</cite> <cite index="47-4">The regulator found that the bank had paid interest on deposits held in certain current accounts and had undertaken activities in the nature of 'synthetic securitisation'.</cite>
